description: We are Team Charlie's Angels, a group of enthusiastic learners and doers who turn ideas into working solutions. We bring skills in full-stack development, data processing, AI, and UI/UX design, and we thrive on learning fast and delivering under pressure. We joined the NASA Space Apps Challenge to show what we’re capable of and to put our skills to use for a meaningful, impactful cause. We believe technology should be powerful, accessible, and built to make a real difference.
